chunks: From him, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Abi al-A'la, who said:

I entered the Sacred Mosque and saw a slave of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), so I turned to him to ask him about Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). Behold, it was Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in prostration. I waited for him for a long time, and his prostration was prolonged for me, so I stood up and prayed some cycles of prayer and finished, while he was still in prostration. I asked his slave, 'When did he prostrate?' He said, 'From before I came in.' When he heard my speech, he raised his head, then said, 'O Abu Muhammad, come closer to me.' So I approached him and greeted him. He heard a voice behind him, so he said, 'What are these raised voices?' I said, 'These are a group of the Murji'ah, the Qadariyyah, and the Mu'tazilah.' He said, 'The people want me, so come with us.' I stood up and went with him. When they saw him, they stood up towards him, so he said to them, 'Restrain yourselves from me and do not hurt me and expose me to the authorities, for I am not a Mufti (issuer of fatwas) for you.' Then he took my hand, left them, and went away.

When he exited the mosque, he said to me, 'O Abu Muhammad! By Allah, if Iblis had prostrated to Allah, Mighty is His Remembrance, after disobedience and arrogance for the entire life of the world, that would not benefit him, nor would Allah accept it, as long as he did not prostrate to Adam as Allah, Exalted and Majestic, commanded him to prostrate to him. And similarly is this disobedient and bewildered nation after their Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and after they abandoned the Imam whom their Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) appointed for them. So Allah, Blessed and Exalted, will never accept any deed from them, nor raise any good deed for them, until they come to Allah, Exalted and Majestic, from where He commanded them, and befriend the Imam whom they were commanded to accept his Wilayah, and enter through the Door which Allah, Exalted and Majestic, and His Messenger opened for them.'

O Abu Muhammad! Surely Allah has made five obligations obligatory upon the nation of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family): Salat, Zakat, Sawm, Hajj, and our Wilayah. He granted concession in some matters of the four obligations, but He did not grant concession to any of the Muslims in abandoning our Wilayah. No, by Allah, there is no concession in it.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Wilayah in relation to the acceptance of other acts of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia doctrine that Wilayah (divine leadership) is a fundamental pillar of faith, equal in obligation to the five major acts of worship. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) illustrates this by comparing the rejection of Iblis’s prostration—due to his refusal to submit to Adam’s authority—to the rejection of the Ummah’s deeds if they neglect the Imam appointed by the Prophet. The narration emphasizes that while concessions (rukhas) may apply to ritual pillars like prayer and fasting, there is no exemption from the duty of recognizing and following the Imams.
